note: The 55 alerts of common/alerts.txt and their entry texts (docs/specs/07_interface/05_text_sweep.md family alerts). The realm speaks as we; the instant text is the alert's title, the delayed text its description. The alerts of systems ZIN removes (cryptology, raids, operatives) keep text so that a stray one cannot show a modern word. The energy and Stored Essence alerts are in alerts.energy.json, which the economy engineer may adjust.

lit.LOW_SUPPLIES_TIPS:
These steps may help you set the matter right:
 - Spread your hosts out or move them elsewhere to lessen the local use of supply.

 - Improve the roads and make sure no {rail_way:lc} bottleneck lies between the capital and the army.

 - If you have enough {truck:p:lc}, you can give the {supply_node:p:lc} of the region more of them, which raises their supply cap and reach.

If supply in the area comes by sea, you can also:
 - Raise the level of the harbours at both ends of the route.

 - Make sure you have enough {convoy:p:lc}.

 - Guard the {convoy:p:lc} along the route with the Guard mission. Deliveries slow when ships are sunk.
